claire (PM): Quick thread to lock the rollout pattern for routing-fallback v4. Objective: safer ramps + faster quality signal. Idea: small targeted cohorts + region-first ramp.
omar (eng): Outline the slices you want?
claire (PM): internal -> targeted_highq (0.5%) -> eu_beta (2%) -> regional_25 (25% regional) -> global. Keep each step gated by quality & perf.
vik (data): For targeted_highq pick 2 multi-tenant high-volume customers and 1 synthetic high-throughput cohort. That should give ~30k reqs in <24h.
rachel (sre): Ops rules: auto-revert if p99 latency jumps >200ms for 10m OR error-rate delta >1% absolute. Also cap ramp to 5% per 10m.
omar (eng): We'll add a 10m warmup to prime KV cache before collecting metrics. Flag format: ff.routing.fallback.v4.{slice}.{region}.
claire (PM): Regional priority: EU -> US-east -> APAC. EU thresholds stricter: error delta trigger 0.6%; others 1%.
vik (data): Quality thresholds: hallucination delta <=0.7%, truncation <=0.8%, intent-mistag <=0.4%. If any fail, block promotion.
rachel (sre): I'll prepare runbook for one-click rollback and partial-region toggles. Also add a manual approval after targeted_highq.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued canary ff.routing.fallback.v4.internal at 1777771500 by claire.
claire (PM): Action items: omar -> flag + PR + per-region thresholds; rachel -> runbook + alert templates; vik -> cohort selection + quick dashboard. Target timeline: smoke tomorrow, staged ramp next Tue. Any objections?
omar (eng): None. PR incoming.
vik (data): I'll post expected time-to-signal numbers in the doc.
rachel (sre): +1 from ops. Locking schedule if no objections. :thumbsup:
